note: the gun deck (docs/shipkit-12), in the ship's frame (metres): frames, the parts on frames of their own (the capstan's head GunCapstan, origin on its axis at the deck, z up, turning about it; the great cabin's doors CabinDoor_S and CabinDoor_P, origin on the hinge at the deck, x across the leaf toward the latch, z up, opening as cabin_doors says); layout, where each fitting stands (x of its centre, its inside size); lights, the lanterns' lights (a point light in each lantern's body: its zone, colour, kelvin, lumens, radius and whether it casts shadows) within light_budget, light_zones_note and lumens_note saying how to light by zone and why so bright; below, what the game loads when below: the collection GunDeck (objects, its meshes; lights, the lanterns' lights), the long guns' copies in their pose collections with the lid lanyards that go with each pose, and zones, which lights' zones each object facing into the gun deck is in (names ending in * are prefixes); planking, the deck's planks drawn from its 'Planking' and 'Margin' UVs as the spar deck's (deck.json), and the floor cloth's squares from its 'Cloth' UV (a square a unit); cables, the cables' course on the deck from the hawse holes over the manger to the cable scuttles; gear, the guns' own gear: the implements over each gun, the shot garlands, the lids' lanyards (LanyardFittings, the bushes and cleats, and LidLanyards, the rope inside and the bridle ports' lanyards, always shown; outside, LidLanyards_Shut with the lids shut and the guns housed, LidLanyards_Open with them opened lid_open_deg as the guns run in and out: show the one that goes with the lids; each lid's two rings are built into it and turn with it); copies, each housed gun's tompion and apron (mesh, 4x4 in the ship's frame; shown with the guns housed, as guns.json's housed pose); the rest are the builder's records of where its parts fell (among them knees_x_m and lodging_knees, the hanging and lodging knees; capstan_bars, the bars stowed in racks overhead; galley; window_seat; after_wall with its panelling)

CabinDoor_S.opens: a turn about its own Z by open_sign x up to open_deg swings it aft into the cabin

CabinDoor_P.opens: a turn about its own Z by open_sign x up to open_deg swings it aft into the cabin

light_budget.note: fourteen lanterns, unshadowed, and the cabin's, shadowed (its radius 4 m); the ports and hatches give daylight: no light probes below in this slice (the PC lane's to add if the frame allows)

light_zones_note: each light is in a zone (gun_deck, great_cabin): in the game a light should light only the objects of its own zone (lighting channels: gundeck.json below.zones), or, unshadowed, it shines through the planks onto the spar deck's guns and the berth deck below, and through the side onto the sea and the channels. The deck's lanterns reach no further than the cabin's bulkhead (each one's radius_m stops short of its fore face) and the cabin's casts shadows, so neither shines through the bulkhead
lumens_note: set for the game's exposure below decks, not a candle's: a tallow candle gives about 12 lm and a horn lantern passes less than that, so a period gun deck at night was far darker than the game shows it (the PC lighting lane tunes it against the exposure, VisualPipeline's incident meter)

pose_collections.Guns_Housed: the long guns housed for sea, the lids shut, with LidLanyards_Shut and the copies' tompions and aprons (copies)
pose_collections.Guns_RunIn: the long guns run in, the lids open lid_open_deg, with LidLanyards_Open
pose_collections.Guns_RunOut: the long guns run out, the lids open as for Guns_RunIn, with LidLanyards_Open

below.irons: each long gun's irons (Gun24_<side><port>_Irons) are in the collection Guns with the carronades' slides
below.seen_from_outside: the waist and the hatchways look down into it from the spar deck, and the open ports and the stern and side windows into it from close alongside: the export lane's light copy covers those views
